profile.name: Tango控制系统代理组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于在实验控制环境中通过 Tango 资源定位符（TRL）连接属性与命令信号。它提供数值读写、配置与读数获取、事件订阅、轮询参数设置以及数据转换等功能，常用于将实验设备信号接入上层采集、监测和自动化流程。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component used to connect attribute and command signals through Tango Resource Locators (TRLs) in laboratory control environments. It provides value read/write access, configuration and reading retrieval, event subscription, polling setup, and data conversion, and is typically used to integrate experiment device signals into higher-level acquisition, monitoring, and automation workflows.
